evidence.quote: one of the most widely used polycrystalline superalloys is Inconel 718 (IN718), which is primarily strengthened by a dispersion of ordered γ 00 (Ni3Nb, D022, tetragonal, I4=mmm) precipitates
In these alloys, Nb also provides potent solid solution strengthening, although this mechanism is limited by a relatively low solubility in the γ matrix.
